positioning: A durable, evidence-grounded conversational assistant for finding quote leads and merchant-page entry points for known product models in the Singapore service market.

invariants.statement: A quote lookup requires a confirmed model; unresolved or typo-suspected model text is clarified without a provider call.
The Singapore service scope is fixed inside the provider adapter and is never a user goal or delivery-destination question.
Returned records are quote leads for merchant-page confirmation and are never published as product recommendations or global best prices.
Provider results distinguish non-degraded results, non-degraded empty responses, degraded responses, and failures; HTTP 200 alone is insufficient.
The user quote path never falls back automatically to catalog keyword, semantic, hybrid, or REST sorted search.
Normalization may change punctuation, case, Unicode form, and spacing but never silently changes model letters or digits.
A record is user-visible only after exact model, required qualifier, and requested item-role checks; insufficient evidence remains excluded.
Accessory, replacement, repair, part, and service records cannot enter a primary-product QuoteLead.
Every provider record is retained as a QuoteObservation even when rejected or grouped.
QuoteLeads group only records with the same normalized merchant target URL and condition; record count is never merchant count.
Original amount and currency remain primary; CNY is an optional estimate with an FX observation timestamp.
Provider availability may be retained as evidence but never produces a current-stock claim or ranking signal.
Every visible QuoteLead carries an HTTPS handoff and a mandatory final-price, exact-model/version, condition, and purchasability confirmation disclosure.
Stored artifacts may support audit and same-conversation follow-up but cross-conversation cache never substitutes for a new quote lookup or refresh.
Focus, comparison, exclusion, explanation, and ordinary follow-up use the current QuoteLeadSet without a provider call when evidence is sufficient.
Goal, dialogue, QuoteLeadSet, claims, assistant message, status, and events publish atomically and stale attempts cannot publish.
A legacy cross-market recommendation conversation is not silently migrated into a Singapore quote lookup.
After cutover there is one active quote-lead business implementation without dual write, legacy runtime fallback, or hidden recommendation path.
